༄༅/ /mkha' 'gro yang tig gi dbang bskur ba'i lag len/mkha' 'gro snying thig gi dkyil 'khor bri tshul rnams bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mkha' 'gro yang tig gi dbang bskur ba'i lag len/ mkha' 'gro snying thig gi dkyil 'khor bri tshul rnams bzhugs so/ /

na mo gu ru/ mkhyen stobs baiḍūr gsar pa'i bum bzang nas/ /smin byed dbang bzhi'i 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /bdag blo'i za ma tog tu stsal mkhas pa/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rdzogs pa chen po mkha' 'gro snying thig gi dbang bskur ba'i tshul la/ snying thig rtsa ba'i dbang chog ma bu dum bur bcad pa rnams go rim rgyu ru lugs su bkod pa dang*/ der ma tshang ba 'ga' zhig o rgyan yab yum gyis gdams pa'i gnad bkrol te mngon sum stsal ba la brten nas chos rje kun mkhyen chen pos rtsa ba gter byon gyi dgongs pa zab cing brlings pa rnams gsal por bkral ba mkha' 'gro yang tig tu grags pa'i gzhung gzhan dang ma 'dres shing rang rkang tshugs pa mdzad pa'i de nyid kyi nang tshan rin po che dbang gi phreng ba nyid bklag chog nag 'gros su bkod pa yin 'dug na'ang rdul tshon bzhengs pa gzhir bzhag sgrub chen dang 'dres pas cung zad dbye dka' bas/ da lta yul dus dang 'tshams pa'i phyag len phal che ba zhig ras bris la brten pa mang bas de'i tshul ni/ thog mar sa chog ni grub na legs kyang ras bris kyi phyogs la mi dgos pas gong du dkyil 'khor bshams pa'i sa gzhi khod snyoms pa'i maṇḍal la dri'i thig le la me tog gi tshom bu slob dpon gyis lha so so'i sngags brjod bzhin du bkod/ /rnal rgyal bum pa bcu'am lnga/ ma 'byor na gcig gis kyang rung ste/ las bum bcas pa rnams so so'i chas su byas pa rgyun 'bab kyi chus sum gnyis bkang ba la rdzas nyer lngas sbags pa gtsang ma'i stegs la bkod/ mtha' bskor gyi mdun du mchod gtor sman raka can dang*/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga g.yas bskor du bsham/ rdor dril/ ku sha srung skud/ khyor chu/ bdud rtsi lnga'i ril bu/ so shing rnams 'du bya/ de nas sta gon gyi cho ga byed tshul dbang chog ltar las phyag bzhes spyi tsam la sbyin sreg ma grub kyang chog

/gsol gdab kyi gong du slob ma khrus dang phyag byas gral la 'khod cing bgegs bskrad/ sta gon gyi sngon du bshad pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ nyams chag skong ba gsol gdab kyi le tshan rnams skabs 'dir bya/ de nas slob ma'i blo bcos pa'i chos bshad ci rigs skabs sbyar gyi sngon du btang nas/ sta gon dngos gzhi rmi lam brtags pa'i bar dkyus bzhin byas te de nas slob ma rang gnas su btang dkyil 'khor gyi lhar gsol gdab dang rjes chog bya/ nyin dang po'i cho ga'o// // ༈ de nas dbang chog dngos gzhi la yo byad bsham pa ni/ ras bris kyi khar mañdzi so so'i steng du rnam rgyal bum pa rnams kyi kha rgyan gyi gseb tu shel dang rma bya me long rnams btsugs pa bkod/ phyogs ci bder rigs lnga'i sku 'bag /dbu rgyan/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ mdun g.yas su rta mgrin gyi gtor ma/ bar du mchod gtor sman raka can g.yon du srog sgrub dang*/ phyogs ci bder rig 'dzin gyi gtor ma/ gza' bdud/ shan pa dmar nag /g.yu sgron ma rnams so so'i gtor ma sku 'bag can/ g.yas su gsang dbang gi dkyil 'khor phyag len bzhin bris pa'i khar thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba/ rgyab tu rig ma'i tsaka li/ g.yon du dbang bzhi pa'i bcas shom/ phyogs ci bder ka dag rtsal dbang*/ thod rgal rtsal dbang*/ mkha' 'gro'i don dbang gsum pad 'dab 'ad ོ ra thod pa bcud ldan gyi bcas gcig gis 'thus/ slob ma mchog la bka' gtad byed par spro yang shom zur pa med/ dkyil 'khor rgyan bkod zhib par dbang chog ltar dang*/ bsdu na de dag gi mtha' skor du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nye ra spyod/ spos/ mar me/ lha bshos/ tshogs mchod rnams gzab rgyas su bshams/ phyag len rgyas pa'i lugs su dbang rnams dum bur zhag grangs kyis chod par bskur na bsham bkod 'dor len gyi skabs phyed par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor sgrub pa ni/ dbang chog las/ sta gon du bya ba'i skabs bzhin byas la mchod bstod bkra shis brjod/

ces gsungs shing*/ de'i don ni rang nyid gzhi'i kun bzang du gsal btab/ mdun gyi bum pa bskyed bzlas 'od zhu ba'i bar bya/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor lha bskyed nas bstod pa'i bar dkyus bzhin bya/ bdag mdun la bzlas pa byed dgos pa'i gsal kha ma byung zhing*/ rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po ltar na bden gnyis dbyer med snod bcud dag mnyam chen por ye nas gnas pa'i gzhi rgyud bde gshegs snying po skye 'gags gnas gsum dang bral ba'i rtsal snang lha skur shar ba las slob gsar du sgro btags pa ma yin pa'i nges shes rnyed cing rlung 'gro 'ong gzhom med sngags kyi rang bzhin du gnas par shes pa ni don dam gyi bzlas pa yin pas bar bkab ma byas kyang chog /yang dkyil 'khor sgrub pa las/ bzlas pa'i rim pa skabs ltar bya/ zhes pas/ rigs lnga'i sgrub thabs ltar bzlas pa byas kyang legs so/ / yang dbang gi byed las bum pa gtso bas bum bzlas byas pas khyab ces bla mas gsungs/ tshul 'di ni snying thig rtsa ba'i dbang chog las/ rigs lnga nang sgrub bdag bskyed/ phyi sgrub mdun bskyed/ ces gsungs pas gong gi bdag bskyed gzhi'i kun bzang nyid rigs lnga nang sgrub lus dkyil gyi sgom gzhi yin pa dang*/ phyi sgrub mdun bskyed dang lha grangs rgyas bsdus las 'od zer 'phros pa'i bskyed pa la sogs mngon rtogs ltar bya'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas gsal bar bstan no/ /des ni bum dbang gi sgrub mchod song nas/ dbang chog las/ bdag 'jug dgos par gsungs pa grub na legs shing*/ /padma klong yangs ltar bya/ da lta'i phyag len du/ dam ye dbyer med du rtogs pa bdag 'jug gi ngo bo yin pa gsal 'debs su rig pa'i me tog dor bas go bcad pa gzhan la bskur thabs rgyas bsdus 'tshams pas shin tu legs so/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la slob ma bcug pa'i gnang ba zhus nas/ khrus dang bgegs bskrad nas bsrung 'khor gsal btab/

chos bshad rgyas bsdus skabs sbyar gyi mthar/ 'di nyid kyi lo rgyus rgyas par bshad nas/ bum dbang nas gtad rgya'i bar dbang chog gzhung nyid las 'phri bsnan bya rgyu med kyang*/ dbang gong ma gsum dus bdag bskyed rta mgrin yab yum du bsgom dgos pa dbang bzhi stan thog gcig tu bskur ba yin na/ slob dpon gyis chog la ma ltos par dmigs pa 'phral du bsgyur ba gnas bsgyur gyi lugs dbang chog gzhung du yod pa de ka ltar byas pas khyab/ dbang rnams dus so sor bskur na/ dbang gi 'grel pa las/ gsang dbang man chad gsang sgrub dhākki lngas bskur ba yin te: zhes gsungs pas rigs lnga gsang sgrub rta phag gi lus dkyil la brten pa'i sgom bzlas byas kyang legs so/ /dbang bzhi pa rig pa cer mthong du ngo sprad pa lha bskyed ched du bcos mi dgos te/ rgyal ba zhi khro thams cad bzhi cha gsum bral gyi rig pa chos sku'i ngo bo las ma 'das pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang snga ma las rang rig cer mthong du ngo sprod pa ni yang gsang gi sgrub pa'o/ /zhes pas shes so/ /dbang chog las mchog dbang gi bdag bskyed kha bsgyur skad cig krong bskyed kyis go mi chod snyam pa'i rtog ge'i ngan rtog gis bslad par mi bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni gang 'dul gyi mos ngor 'char ba sgyu ma lta bu'i rnam 'phrul la mnga' brnyes pa yin la/ rnam pa lam byed kyi dus su yang rten 'brel gyi rol pa ma 'gags pa'i tshul du gang dgos skabs dang sbyar nas gnas 'gyur ba ni/ gnyug ma'i sems nyid lhan skyes nyid lam dang 'bras bu'i chos thams cad kyi 'char gzhi yin pas gzhi 'bras gnyis su med pa'i gnad gal po che'o/ /gsar ma ba kha cig ltar lha sku mtshan 'dzin gyi rtog par a 'thas par ni rdzogs pa chen po'i lugs las gzhan du gyur pa'o/ / tshogs mchod las byang zur bkol ltar dbang grol nas btang na bde zhing de skabs kyang lha bskyed dgos pa yang gcig shugs gcig 'gags kyi chu las nya ldang ba'i tshul du bsgaum zhing*/

srung ma'i gtor chog dang dbang gi rjes chog bzod gshegs/ nyer bsdu bsngo smon shis brjod rnams tshogs mchod las 'byung ba bzhin byas pas 'thus so/ /de skad bshes gnyen mchog de'i bzhed skong du/ rje btsun bla mas bka' stsal ji bzhin du/ 'gyur med bstan 'phel bdag gis bkod pa'i dges/ mkha' mnyam 'gro rnams smin cing grol bar shog /mkha' 'gro snying thig gi dkyil 'khor bri tshul ni/ phyi nas me rim bzhin ri rdo ra dur khrod pad phreng rnams ni spyi dang 'dra/ dur khrod kyi bkod pa gzhan spyi dang 'dra zhing rnying ma la rū tra'i rdzas brgyad bkod legs thang rnying phal cher na lho'i dur khrod kyi dbus su rū tra'i mgo song bar 'dug kyang deng song phyag len la lho'i dur khrod kyi zur du bkod/ lho nub phyogs su/ gzhan rnams kyang dur khrod so so'i zur du bri/ g.yas skor du/ 'di ltar lho nub tu lag g.yon/ nub tu snying*/ nub byang du rkang g.yon/ byang du gsang rdor/ byang shar du rkang g.yas/ shar du glo ba/ shar lhor lag g.yas te thams cad 'phrul shes dgos/ pad 'dab mdzes tshon mtshan so gnyis kyi brdar 'dab ma so gnyis so/ /ze'u 'bru ser/ lte ba ljang gu pa tra ris/ dkyil 'khor dngos gzhi la rta babs snam bu bzhi la snam bu bzhi po 'og nas rim bzhin dmar sngo ljang ser bya/ rtsig pa la nang nas rim bzhin sngo dkar ser dmar ljang ba'o/ /lha gnas dang sgo'i bar gyi khyams rnams ni phyogs mdog pa tra ris/ lha gnas la lte ba la li khri/ de'i phyi ra cha phran gcig tsam mu khyud sngo skya/ de'i phyi mu khyud de las nyis 'gyur ser po/ de'i phyir pad 'dab bzhi phyogs mdog/ de'i phyir rdo ra/ de'i phyir pad phreng dmar po/ de'i phyir 'khor lo'i gzhi dkar po la rgya skyegs kyi ri mos 'di ltar bcad 'dug rtsibs 'di ltar dkar po/ lha bkod tshul ni lte bar rnam snang mthing ga

/'khor dril 'khor lo'i yu ba can 'dzin pa/ yum sngo skya/ 'dab ma bzhi la shar nas rim pa bzhin/ rigs bzhi yab yum phyogs mdog yab rnams g.yas rang rtags phyag rgya dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu yum rnams rdo dril 'dzin nas yab mgul 'khyud pa/ yang tig tu yum rnams gri thod 'dzin pa byas 'dug /sgo bzhi'i nang du sgo ba yab yum rnams byang sgo'i g.yas rgya gram g.yon dril bu 'dug phyogs mdog yang rnams g.yas rang rtags phyag rgya yum rnams kyang g.yas rang rtags yab dang mtshungs so/ khro bo'i chas can no/ /ras gzhi'i phyi'i sa stong lus pa rnams sngon po'am ljang gu la pa tra ris la mu ran dmar po byas pa sogs/ gzhan rnams spyi dang 'dra'o/ /gsang dbang la phyi rol me ri/ de'i nang sa stong dang mtshams su mu ran nag po lte ba'i gzhi ljang gu pa tra ris/ de'i nang chos 'byung phyi ma logs mdun bstan nang ma zur mdun bsnol ma phyi dmar skya nang dmar po/ de'i nang me long sin dhu ras byugs pa mtshon byed zlum po mdog rang sa de lte bar gri thod kyis mtshan pa'o/ / ༈ srog sgrub ma la phyi rol me ri/ de'i nang thod skam kha phyir bstan gyi phreng ba/ de'i nang khrag mtsho/ de'i nang chos 'byung zur mdun bstan gy-i dbus su chu gri dang zur gsum du chu grigasum rgyab yol nang dmar phyi pa tra ris su bris pa/ zur gsum du'ang 'di 'dra ba gsum bri'o/ /'di rnams ni rab rdul tshon/ / 'bring ras bris la bri dgos rgyu yin/ gter chen bla ma'i dkyil thang la ji ltar 'dug pa bzhin yin/ kun mkhyen chen po'i phyag len ma 'phyugs pa yin gsungs/ / dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (6)mkha' 'gro snying thig gi dkyil 'khor bri tshul rnams/ - PAGE 186 -- PAGE 187 - - PAGE 180 -
